posts.title: That's me!
posts.description: Hey, that’s really me - leave something below if you ever stop by! My name is Nikita Krupitskas. I’m a software engineer specializing in rendering, game engine architecture, web graphics, and performance - the kind of beautiful technical problems I never get tired of.
